description: This file implements a feature for editing user details within an ASP.NET Core application, including a command, its validation, and the handler logic.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user properties that can be updated.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the user data to be updated.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class that ensures the command contains valid data.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user update command, applies changes to the database, and returns the updated user data encapsulated in a UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method executing the update process: fetches current user, applies updates, hashes password if provided, saving changes to the database and returning the resulting user object.
